name: Slippery Frog 10
author: alexruix
description: Rounded white search input that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, the outline is removed, border-color becomes #ea4c89, background-color changes from #f3f3f4 to #fff. On focus, the outline is removed, border-color becomes #ea4c89, background-color changes from #f3f3f4 to #fff.
